newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh expands VAT net in 1997/98 budget.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh expands VAT net in 1997/98 budget.

text.p: Bangladesh Finance Minister S.A.M.S. Kibria on Thursday proposed to bring more than a dozen fresh products and services into the Value Added Tax (VAT) net in 1997/98 fiscal year, beginning on July 1.
Kibria, while announcing the new year's budget in parliament, proposed to extend VAT to retail transactions of electronic, electrical, sanitary items, three wheelers and motorcycles.
Air conditioned bus and ferry services and satellite cable operators were too brought under the VAT net.
Lifting of VAT exemptions on manufacturers of PVC pipe, metal container, body and chassis of motorised vehicles, soap, electrical bulb, battery and wires and cables were also proposed.
Kibria said expansion of VAT would fetch 700 million taka in additional revenue in 1997/98.
